items.title: Microsoft廣告開放轉換API

items.title: Meta Muse擴展至新加坡，購物與旅遊連接功能將逐步開放

items.summary_en: In an announcement dated October 27, Meta confirmed Muse availability in Singapore on iOS, Android and the web, naming local connector partners including Shopee, Grab, Singapore Airlines and Klook.
items.why: 對面向東南亞消費者的零售及旅遊品牌，AI代理的比較、探索與預訂路徑值得納入渠道規劃，尤其要確認產品資料及服務條款能否被準確呈現。

items.next_step: 確認品牌是否已有合作平台連接，選一條旅遊或購物路徑檢視資料完整度、授權及確認步驟。

用戶決定可存取的服務及資料；購買或寄送電郵等敏感動作前須確認。
highlights_en: Connector features roll out progressively, with some experiences arriving after launch.

items.title: TikTok在新加坡發布Brand Safety Center與AI廣告安全指南
items.title_en: TikTok introduces a Brand Safety Center and AI advertising safety guidance in Singapore

items.why: 品牌安全涉及廣告鄰接內容、創作者披露與AI內容標示，適合整合成同一份上稿前檢查表，而非只設定單一庫存篩選。

items.next_step: 檢視現行Inventory Filter、排除清單及AI素材披露流程，向帳戶團隊確認可用資源與權限。

公告將品牌保護分為安全環境、真實連結及清晰披露，並提及AI生成內容標籤。
highlights_en: AI Safety Essentials was developed with Responsible Marketing Advisory for responsible AI advertising creativity.
The announcement groups protection into safe spaces, real connections and clear disclosure, including AI-generated content labels.

TikTok於10月28日宣布Brand Safety Center、Brand Protection Playbook及AI Safety Essentials，並表示在新加坡APAC Responsible Media Forum介紹相關資源。

AI Safety Essentials由TikTok與Responsible Marketing Advisory合作制定，聚焦負責任的AI廣告創意。

公告將品牌保護分為安全環境、真實連結及清晰披露，並提及AI生成內容標籤。

檢視現行Inventory Filter、排除清單及AI素材披露流程，向帳戶團隊確認可用資源與權限。

指南與平台控制不能保證零風險；本刊未將平台自報移除率或品牌信任數字當作獨立成效。
items.detail_en:
TikTok announced its Brand Safety Center, Brand Protection Playbook and AI Safety Essentials on October 28, presenting the resources at its APAC Responsible Media Forum in Singapore.

AI Safety Essentials was developed with Responsible Marketing Advisory for responsible AI advertising creativity.

The announcement groups protection into safe spaces, real connections and clear disclosure, including AI-generated content labels.

Brand safety spans ad adjacency, creator disclosures and AI labeling. Teams can consolidate these checks into a pre-publication workflow.

Review Inventory Filter, exclusion lists and AI creative disclosures, then confirm resource access with the account team.

Guidance and platform controls do not guarantee zero risk. Platform-reported removal and brand-trust figures are not treated as independent outcomes.

items.title: Sprinklr調查：536名正式使用AI的受訪者中，27%稱能精確量化結果
items.title_en: Sprinklr survey: 27% of 536 live-AI users say they can precisely quantify outcomes
items.summary: Sprinklr與Metric Sherpa於10月28日公布Show Your Work調查。在536名所屬機構有AI應用常態運作的受訪者中，92%稱表現達到或超出預期，27%稱能用紀錄或報表精確量化結果。
items.summary_en: Sprinklr and Metric Sherpa released Show Your Work on October 28. Among 536 respondents whose organizations had AI in regular live use, 92% said it met or exceeded expectations and 27% said they could quantify outcomes precisely using records or reports.
items.why: 滿意度與可量化證據是兩種不同訊號。品牌評估AI工具時，可先定義基準、責任人及比較方法，避免把主觀滿意視為已證實ROI。
items.why_en: Satisfaction and quantified evidence are different signals. Teams can define baselines, owners and comparison methods before treating positive perceptions as demonstrated ROI.
items.next_step: 選一項AI應用，記錄投入前基準、業務指標、資料來源及覆核日期，再決定擴大或調整。
items.next_step_en: For one AI use case, document the baseline, business metric, data source and review date before deciding whether to scale or change it.
highlights: 整體樣本為807名美國行銷、服務及客戶體驗從業者；標題分析採用536人的正式使用子樣本。
網上調查於9月8日至23日進行；結果屬自報，未經獨立稽核。
報告提出成果、責任人、基準、比較及覆核五項量度要素。
highlights_en: The total sample was 807 U.S. marketing, service and CX practitioners; headline analysis used the 536-person live-use subgroup.
The online survey ran September 8–23; results are self-reported and were not independently audited.
The report proposes five measurement disciplines: outcome, owner, baseline, comparison and review.
items.detail:
Sprinklr與Metric Sherpa於10月28日公布Show Your Work調查。在536名所屬機構有AI應用常態運作的受訪者中，92%稱表現達到或超出預期，27%稱能用紀錄或報表精確量化結果。

整體樣本為807名美國行銷、服務及客戶體驗從業者；標題分析採用536人的正式使用子樣本。

網上調查於9月8日至23日進行；結果屬自報，未經獨立稽核。

報告提出成果、責任人、基準、比較及覆核五項量度要素。

滿意度與可量化證據是兩種不同訊號。品牌評估AI工具時，可先定義基準、責任人及比較方法，避免把主觀滿意視為已證實ROI。

選一項AI應用，記錄投入前基準、業務指標、資料來源及覆核日期，再決定擴大或調整。

數字反映美國特定從業者自報，不代表全部企業；27%不等同其餘AI應用無效，亦不構成產品成效證明。
items.detail_en:
Sprinklr and Metric Sherpa released Show Your Work on October 28. Among 536 respondents whose organizations had AI in regular live use, 92% said it met or exceeded expectations and 27% said they could quantify outcomes precisely using records or reports.

The total sample was 807 U.S. marketing, service and CX practitioners; headline analysis used the 536-person live-use subgroup.

The online survey ran September 8–23; results are self-reported and were not independently audited.

The report proposes five measurement disciplines: outcome, owner, baseline, comparison and review.

Satisfaction and quantified evidence are different signals. Teams can define baselines, owners and comparison methods before treating positive perceptions as demonstrated ROI.

For one AI use case, document the baseline, business metric, data source and review date before deciding whether to scale or change it.

These are self-reports from selected U.S. practitioners, not all businesses. The 27% finding does not establish that other AI deployments failed or prove product efficacy.

items.title: Triton公布音訊廣告Seller Agent交易案例，事前由人手設定價格與驗證規則
items.title_en: Triton reports an agent-to-agent audio ad buy with human-defined guardrails
items.summary: Triton Digital於10月28日公布Seller Agent，並表示已與Talpa Media及代理商Draft Digital為Otrium完成一宗由AI代理溝通及預訂的音訊廣告交易。
items.summary_en: Triton Digital announced its Seller Agent on October 28 and said it completed an agent-to-agent audio ad transaction for Otrium with Talpa Media and agency Draft Digital.

items.summary_en: Sprinklr opened its Marketing AI Agents beta on October 27, naming agents for ideation, creative, campaign execution, compliance, community and budget optimization, with people retaining strategy and approvals.

有意參與beta的客戶需聯絡帳戶團隊。

items.title: Microsoft推出MAI Image 2.7圖像編輯預覽，先提供改光與場景修改

items.summary_en: Microsoft AI announced the MAI Image 2.7 preview on October 27 for scene, lighting, text and symbol edits and image restoration. Text-to-image generation is still described as forthcoming.

items.title: 百度開源Unlimited OCR 2，主打長文件結構化及跨頁表格合併
items.title_en: Baidu releases Unlimited OCR 2 for long-document structure and cross-page tables
items.summary: 百度於10月27日宣布開源文心Unlimited OCR 2，描述可輸出結構化文件、識別版面要素及合併跨頁表格；生產級平台能力另列為公開測試。
items.summary_en: Baidu announced open-source Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 on October 27, describing structured document output, layout recognition and cross-page table merging. Production-oriented platform capabilities are separately offered in public testing.
items.why: 處理研究報告、供應商文件及多頁產品資料的行銷團隊，可評估抽取流程。這類工具適合減少整理工作，關鍵數字與表格仍需回看原件。
items.why_en: Marketing teams handling research, supplier documents and product information can evaluate extraction workflows, retaining original-page checks for critical numbers and tables.
items.next_step: 先用公開、非敏感文件比較表格欄位、閱讀順序及跨頁合併，再檢查授權及部署要求。
items.next_step_en: Compare table fields, reading order and cross-page merging on public non-sensitive documents, then check licensing and deployment requirements.
highlights: 官方描述可識別標題、段落、表格、公式及圖片等版面要素，並輸出結構層級。
公告提供GitHub與Hugging Face模型入口；平台生產級能力須另行參與公測。
highlights_en: Baidu describes recognizing headings, paragraphs, tables, formulas and images with structural hierarchy.
The announcement links GitHub and Hugging Face; production platform capabilities require separate public-test participation.

items.detail_en:
Baidu announced open-source Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 on October 27, describing structured document output, layout recognition and cross-page table merging. Production-oriented platform capabilities are separately offered in public testing.

Baidu describes recognizing headings, paragraphs, tables, formulas and images with structural hierarchy.

The announcement links GitHub and Hugging Face; production platform capabilities require separate public-test participation.

Marketing teams handling research, supplier documents and product information can evaluate extraction workflows, retaining original-page checks for critical numbers and tables.

Compare table fields, reading order and cross-page merging on public non-sensitive documents, then check licensing and deployment requirements.

Capabilities are attributed to Baidu. Benchmark scores and unlimited-length accuracy were not reproduced, and model licensing has not been reviewed.

items.title: Clorox分享AI創意工作方式：投放期間按消費者訊號調整素材
items.title_en: Clorox describes using AI signals to revise creative while campaigns are live
items.summary: Clorox在10月26日文章分享CMO Eric Schwartz於ANA Masters of Marketing的觀點：結合消費者洞察、AI與合作夥伴，讓素材在投放期間持續調整。這是工作方法案例，並非當日新產品發布。
items.summary_en: In an October 26 post, Clorox shared CMO Eric Schwartz’s ANA Masters of Marketing remarks on combining consumer insight, AI and partners to revise live creative. This is a workflow case, not a new product launch.
items.why: 案例提醒品牌把聆聽、製作與審批連成循環。對季節性活動，預先準備可調整的場景與素材版本，可能比等投放後檢討更實用。
items.why_en: Teams can connect listening, production and approval into a repeatable loop. Seasonal campaigns can plan adaptable creative elements before launch.
items.next_step: 選一項投放中的素材，定義可觸發改稿的訊號、批准人及衡量基準，避免只因短期波動頻繁改動。
items.next_step_en: For one live asset, define the signal, approver and measurement baseline that would justify a revision, avoiding reactions to short-term noise.
highlights: Clorox表示PURE團隊以AI訊號了解過敏季節中引起考慮的使用場景，並在無須重拍下修改素材。
文章把社交聆聽視為產品與內容學習來源，並強調人員、AI及夥伴共同參與。
highlights_en: Clorox says its PURE team used AI signals about allergy-season occasions to update creative without a reshoot.
The post frames social listening as input to content and product learning, combining people, AI and partners.

Clorox表示PURE團隊以AI訊號了解過敏季節中引起考慮的使用場景，並在毋須重拍下修改素材。

案例為品牌自述；本刊未核實成本節省或銷售因果關係，也不將其他品牌的表現歸功於AI。
items.detail_en:
In an October 26 post, Clorox shared CMO Eric Schwartz’s ANA Masters of Marketing remarks on combining consumer insight, AI and partners to revise live creative. This is a workflow case, not a new product launch.

Clorox says its PURE team used AI signals about allergy-season occasions to update creative without a reshoot.

The post frames social listening as input to content and product learning, combining people, AI and partners.

Teams can connect listening, production and approval into a repeatable loop. Seasonal campaigns can plan adaptable creative elements before launch.

For one live asset, define the signal, approver and measurement baseline that would justify a revision, avoiding reactions to short-term noise.

This is a brand account. Cost savings and sales causation were not verified, and other brand outcomes are not attributed to AI.

items.title: Rime發布Prism語音模型，以可檢視文字層支援企業對話控制
items.title_en: Rime launches Prism with an inspectable text checkpoint for enterprise voice agents
items.summary: Rime於10月28日公布Prism語音對語音模型，描述可在說話前產生供檢查的文字層，並讓工具呼叫與語音並行；自助微調API仍與beta客戶共同開發。
items.summary_en: Rime announced Prism on October 28, describing a speech-to-speech model with an inspectable text layer before speech and tool calls alongside spoken output. Self-service fine-tuning APIs are still being developed with beta customers.
items.why: 對使用語音代理承接諮詢與訂單的品牌，文字檢查點值得評估：能否在客戶聽到回覆前套用品牌用語與動作限制，比聲音自然程度更關乎流程控制。
items.why_en: Brands using voice agents for inquiries or orders can evaluate whether a text checkpoint supports wording checks and action limits before a response reaches the customer.
items.next_step: 以一個低風險對話檢查人名、產品詞、拒答及執行前確認；向供應商確認語言、部署與微調開放條件。
items.next_step_en: Test names, product terms, refusals and confirmation before action on a low-risk workflow; confirm languages, deployment and fine-tuning access with the supplier.
highlights: Rime把Prism描述為聆聽、寫出將說的內容並在說話時繼續聆聽的系統。
文字層可供規則檢查及修改；自助RL與SFT API尚在與beta客戶開發。
highlights_en: Rime describes a system that listens, writes its intended response and continues hearing the user while speaking.
The text layer can be checked and rewritten; self-service RL and SFT APIs are being built with beta customers.

能力為供應商自述；本刊未重現語音評測。官方及其他報道的延遲口徑不同，本刊不刊載速度比較或全面微調可用聲稱。
items.detail_en:

The text layer can be checked and rewritten; self-service RL and SFT APIs are being built with beta customers.
